requires: OpenBMC image on BMC hardware (or QEMU OpenBMC target)

root_cause.file: n/a (vendor firmware / Linux runtime / hardware fabric)
root_cause.note: OpenBMC/BTI/Redfish: bmcweb (C++), phosphor daemons and the IPMI BT interface are firmware/hardware paths; explicitly unsupported on this host. Existing BMC-surface conclusions live in the bmc-ipmi-exposure and redfish-default-credentials modules; the three SONiC vendor CVEs remain unsupported for the same class of reason.
